lead: Sushma Swaraj was an Indian politician, born on 14 February 1952 in Ambala Cantonment.
She died on 6 August 2019 in New Delhi at the age of 67.
She has held the office of Chief Minister of Delhi and member of Rajya Sabha and has been recognised with Outstanding Parliamentarian Award and Banga Bibhushan.
Below you will find a verified overview of Sushma Swaraj: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Sushma Swaraj — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sushma Swaraj was born on 14 February 1952 in Ambala Cantonment, and holds Indian nationality.
Her listed education includes Kurukshetra University, Panjab University and Sanatan Dharma College.

sections.heading: Sushma Swaraj — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists politician, lawyer, jurist and foreign minister as her occupations.

She has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Delhi (1998–1998), member of Rajya Sabha (1990–1996), Member of the Delhi Legislative Assembly (1998–1998), Member of the Haryana Legislative Assembly (1977–1982), Minister of External Affairs (2014–2019) and Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–2019). She is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
